gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-halant: Plakkaat draws every letter like a bent straw, heavy and closed, with terminals curling round to almost touch the stem. Halant, a text serif, answers with arches that thin as they leave it.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-headland-one: Dignified, this one. Plakkaat's heavy, closed letters sit over Headland One, whose rounded o nearly matches its capital and whose letters keep well apart.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Heavy, bent-straw letters up top. Plakkaat's curled terminals sit over Hedvig Letters Serif, a classic serif with sturdy lowercase and curves left open to breathe.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa reads large and sturdy, its counters spilling into the space around them and its thick and thin strokes barely apart. Plakkaat's true monoline heavy drawing makes the neat contrast.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC is a literary serif whose lowercase stands with the stature of cast iron capitals, its strokes lightly brushed. Plakkaat, by contrast, is a heavy monoline skeleton with curled terminals.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-montagu-slab: Refined is the body's mood, and Montagu Slab earns it with sturdy downstrokes, slender turns and an open e. Plakkaat does the opposite job, closing its heavy monoline letters into loud, bent-straw shapes.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Noto Serif Hentaigana has open jaws on every curve and small letters nearly as tall as its capitals, with visible modulation. Give it generous size, since Plakkaat's heavy lines already carry weight.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-ovo: Ovo is a classic serif whose thins run only slightly lighter than its thicks, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. And its size can stay modest, since Plakkaat's closed, heavy lettering carries the weight.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-esteban: Quantum looks plotted by pen, smooth and loosely spaced. Esteban's oversized lowercase and open e bring a classic serif's warmth, its thin parts only slightly slimmer than the stems.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-faustina: Loose, clean and techy, Quantum keeps its mouths open and its strokes untapered, while Faustina, a text serif, thins its bowls gradually. One is drawn flat, the other shaded softly.
